name: yf_multi_ticker_history
description:
Price history for several tickers in one call from Yahoo Finance (yfinance download).
Returns: {symbols: [...], data: {SYMBOL: up to the first (oldest) 30 daily rows of {Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume}}}; prices are adjusted. With the default 1mo period all rows fit; longer periods are cut to their first 30 days.
Inputs (* required): symbols* (space-separated, e.g. "AAPL MSFT GOOGL"; commas are not split); period (1d, 5d, 1mo, 3mo, ...; default 1mo). The tool sets no ticker limit.
One ticker with up to 500 bars: yf_stock_history; fundamentals side by side: yf_compare_stocks. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbols": "AAPL MSFT GOOGL", "period": "5d"}
